body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An area Action is declared including the target. Response (unopposed): Move the target up to 2 units along a clear path, then recheck whether it remains in the area.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary restraint during that displacement; it resumes if its source still reaches the destination.
